relation: two supplied-map interfaces over an eqType palette: set maps {set G} -> C in the endpoint form (the foundation source converts; X142's intersection and X14's not-disjoint forms are logically equivalent through proper_edge_colouring_edgesP / proper_edge_colouring_meetP) and ordered-pair maps G -> G -> C symmetric on all pairs (X213 and D2chr.proper_ec convert); the supplied maps and labels are unchanged
summary: Batch C, family C6 (`proper_edge_colouring`). Five standalone sources in three areas, kept as TWO supplied-map interfaces of the focused `GTBase.edge_colourings` over an `eqType` palette: set maps `{set G} -> C` read on the doubletons of actual edges (`proper_edge_colouring`, the endpoint form of the public foundation source `Extremal.foundations.edge_colourings.proper_ecolouring`, which stays public under its old name as a transparent adapter; X142's intersection form and X14's not-disjoint form are logically equivalent to it through `proper_edge_colouring_edgesP` / `proper_edge_colouring_meetP`) and ordered-pair maps `G -> G -> C` symmetric on ALL pairs (`proper_pair_edge_colouring`; X213 and D2chr's `proper_ec` convert). The explicit bridge `proper_edge_colouring_pairP` relates a set map to `fun x y => col [set x; y]`; no map on the subtype of actual edges replaces either domain and no line graph is used (upstream `mgraph.line_graph` is directed, `GTBase.base.line_graph` lives on multigraph edge identities). Every live name is now an alias; statement texts, doc blocks, manifest rows, leg states and documented discrepancies are unchanged (checked below).
| `Chromatic.conjectures.X142.x142_proper_edge_colouring` | set map into `'I_k`, distinct intersecting edges | alias of `proper_edge_colouring`; M1's frozen chain reused |
| `Chromatic.conjectures.X213.x213_proper_edge_colouring` | pair map into `'I_k`, symmetric on all pairs | alias of `proper_pair_edge_colouring` (conversion) |
| `GTMisc.conjectures.X14.x14_proper_edge_colouring` | set map into a `finType`, distinct non-disjoint edges | alias of `proper_edge_colouring` |
| `Extremal.conjectures.D2chr.proper_ec` | pair map into a `finType`, symmetric on all pairs | alias of `proper_pair_edge_colouring` (conversion) |

| `Extremal.foundations.edge_colourings.proper_ecolouring` | set map into an `eqType`, endpoint form | public adapter of `proper_edge_colouring` (conversion); registered through `repository_sources` |

Seven rows are affected: X142 (through `x142_neighbour_sum_edge_colourable`; M1's complete frozen chain over the pre-M1 edge comprehension is reused verbatim, its helper certificate re-proved through `proper_edge_colouring_edgesP`, and `Chromatic.migration.edge_colourings` restates this family's helper, chain and row certificates over those bodies), X213's two rows (through `x213_edge_colourable`; `x213_kempe_reach` and `x213_used_colours` stay live, so the whole-function Kempe states and used-colour count are untouched), X14 (Andersen, `n.-1` vertices) and X62 (through `x14_proper_edge_colouring`, with the raw-path vocabulary live), D2chr (through `star_edge_colouring`, `star_edge_k_colourable`, `is_star_chromatic_index`, whose unprefixed names are frozen as `d2chr_*`; the least-index clause and the `K_1 = 1` convention of the pair domain are preserved) and X229 (through the public foundation source; the robust-expander hypotheses and the full palette split are unchanged).

Empty-palette behaviour differs by interface and is grounded rather than unified: no set map into an empty palette exists for any graph (`no_set_map_into_empty_palette`, the domain `{set G}` is inhabited), the empty graph admits every pair map including the one into an empty palette (`proper_pair_edge_colouring_K0`), and a nonempty edgeless graph admits none (`no_pair_map_into_empty_palette`, `proper_pair_edge_colouring_K1`). Constant maps are proper on `K_2` and improper on `K_3` in both interfaces; injective relabelling preserves and reflects properness with the supplied labels kept; set-map values off `E(G)` are irrelevant. The X213.v prose (only adjacent pairs are constrained) disagrees with its body (symmetry on all pairs): C6 records this and changes neither; the X213 one-factorization row stays partial and the Vizing row solved.

Tooling: the public foundation source is absent from the conjecture-only helper inventory, so the `repository_sources` descriptor of the family document (path, pinned commit 3011c28, blob and declaration hash) registers it as an ordinary `kind: source`, as supported by the repository-sources tooling pin 2f15093 on which this family's private baseline is built; X229 is an ordinary corpus row discovered through that source, never `non_corpus`.

Subsequent B6/C6 composition: earlier partial X14Legacy/X62Legacy bodies in both families stay verbatim. GTMisc.migration.edge_colourings.X14Original and X62Original add the complete Andersen/rainbow-cover rows, combining C6 frozen properness over raw pre-M1 edges with B6 frozen genuine_path, plus frozen raw path_edges and edges_covered_by_paths. Both closed original-to-live iff theorems are registered by C6 and checked by both reports. No live properness/path/edge-list/cover alias or either family canonical predicate occurs in these full original bodies; the old partial snapshots retain explicit reciprocal ownership notes. No proof-term identity is claimed.
